content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm facing an issue where I can't upload to my [product_name]. I've added a message text, but when I check the help documentation, it shows a Q connection, which I believe should be linked to the output. Mine doesn't have any connection to Q, as seen in the attached image. Any suggestions?

When using LAD, you can't see that the message text block has a digital output, unlike in FBD. This output needs to be connected to either a digital input of another block, an open connector, a digital flag (M), or a digital output (Q). In FBD, the connection appears, for example, like this: The same setup exists in LAD.
I wouldn't have guessed that—it's not intuitive. I now understand why there needs to be an output; that's something new for me. Thanks for the explanation.

This concept isn't new. There are many blocks with outputs, including analog types. LAD in [product_name] programming isn't as convenient, and it lacks certain options that are available in FBD. This is why I prefer programming in FBD.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience confusion when working with the message text block in [product_name] programming software. The difference in graphical representation of outputs between LAD and FBD views can lead to uncertainty about how to connect outputs, which affects successful configuration uploads to the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want intuitive and consistent visual indicators of block outputs and wiring requirements across all programming views to simplify configuration and uploading processes.
